header: SIMULATED - infrastructure validation, not user-behavior evidence. Persona mix/shares are a DESIGN CHOICE for behavior-space coverage, not a market estimate; never cite as user-behavior evidence (spec sec.8).
purpose: Deterministic simulated-user personas for the SIFT test-bot harness (sift/sim, pull/27): infrastructure soak + v4.1 sec.4.7 anti-abuse attack sims ONLY. NOT user-behavior evidence; the mix is a design choice for coverage, not a market estimate.
constraints: synthetic instruments only (SIM#### from the sim world); personas never name real tickers
bot inputs only; never in product copy; no tickers + directional calls in anything SIFT ships
bot share posts are non-directional test fixtures; no profit-expectation/value language anywhere
bots see only the anonymized aggregates a real card-holder would; raw market data stays server-side
every bot run logs persona id + deterministic_seed; every report carries the SIMULATED header
runs require SIFT_ENV=test (ephemeral test DB only)

personas.name: Big-name anchor
personas.description: Does not know much; locks onto big household names and searches randomly around them. Low session count, few ticks per session.

personas.name: Megacap orbit
personas.description: Picks a couple of mega-cap names from memory and probes whatever the screener surfaces next to them.

personas.name: Brand hunter
personas.description: Thinks in consumer brands; maps brands to tickers by association and runs narrative searches.

personas.name: Ticker-familiar
personas.description: Recognizes a handful of tickers from headlines; everything else is random exploration around those.

personas.name: Headline anchor
personas.description: Anchors on whatever name is in the news this week and chases momentum around it.

personas.name: Mega-ETF anchor
personas.description: Uses the biggest ETF holdings as the anchor set; searches randomly among them.

personas.name: Dow-anchor
personas.description: Knows the Dow components by name; treats them as the whole universe.

personas.name: S&P-top anchor
personas.description: Takes the top of the index list and pairs the first two names it sees.

personas.name: WSB trender
personas.description: Takes whatever is trending on the casino board and tries to find connections for it; short sessions, momentum strategy.

personas.name: WSB DD trender
personas.description: Reads the long DD posts and hunts narrative connections between the mentioned names.

personas.name: WSB options trender
personas.description: Follows unusual-options-flow chatter and momentum-chases the flagged names.

personas.name: Squeeze trender
personas.description: Hops on short-squeeze chatter; high share-post frequency about whatever is moving.

personas.name: Comment-section trender
personas.description: Takes tickers from the top comments rather than the post itself; copycat strategy.

personas.name: Gainers-board trender
personas.description: Runs the top-gainers screener each morning and momentum-chases.

personas.name: Cross-subreddit trender
personas.description: Watches for the same ticker appearing in multiple subreddits and rides it.

personas.name: Reversal trender
personas.description: Looks for overextended trends and tries to pair the extended name against something comparably sized.

personas.name: Top-of-list pairer
personas.description: Takes the first two tickers on the tips list and runs a pairs analysis, no further research.

personas.name: Screener pairer
personas.description: Pairs the first two rows of whatever screener is open.

personas.name: Gainers pairer
personas.description: Pairs the top gainer with the runner-up and checks the spread.

personas.name: Losers pairer
personas.description: Pairs the biggest losers, expecting mean reversion.

personas.name: Most-active pairer
personas.description: Pairs the two most-active names of the day.

personas.name: Upgrade-list pairer
personas.description: Takes the first two names on the analyst-upgrade list and pairs them.

personas.name: Substack verifier
personas.description: Follows free-tier stock-pick newsletters and tries to verify each pick through card runs.

personas.name: Weekly newsletter verifier
personas.description: Verifies each pick in the weekly free letter; longer sessions, methodical.

personas.name: Portfolio verifier
personas.description: Verifies the newsletter's model portfolio against fundamentals before running cards.

personas.name: Free-picks verifier
personas.description: Collects free picks from several sources and cross-verifies them.

personas.name: Discord tip verifier
personas.description: Verifies tips from free Discord communities; posts about verification results.

personas.name: Telegram signal verifier
personas.description: Verifies Telegram signals quickly; high post frequency, momentum-leaning.

personas.name: YouTube pick verifier
personas.description: Watches finance YouTube picks and runs narrative verification on them.

personas.name: Newsletter pairs verifier
personas.description: Specializes in verifying newsletter pair ideas with longer, fundamentals-backed sessions.

personas.name: Influencer miner
personas.description: Listens to hype finance influencers and mines for cards based on whatever they mention.

personas.name: X hype miner
personas.description: Mines trending finance posts; high minting intent and very high share-post frequency.

personas.name: FinTok miner
personas.description: Chases tickers from viral short-video finance clips; very short sessions, very frequent posting.

personas.name: Podcast miner
personas.description: Mines themes from finance podcasts during long sessions.

personas.name: Streamer miner
personas.description: Mines tickers called out during live streams; long sessions while the stream runs.

personas.name: Influencer pair miner
personas.description: Turns influencer pair claims into actual pairs runs.

personas.name: Card farmer
personas.description: Likes the cards themselves; researches easy connections to mint as many cards as possible regardless of quality.

personas.name: Easy-mint farmer
personas.description: Hunts the most obvious pairs on screeners purely to mint cards; very high weekly minting goal.

personas.name: Ghost-farmer
personas.description: Re-runs the same specs to collect numbered ghost cards; highest minting goal in the spec.

personas.name: Share-slot farmer
personas.description: Mints easy cards and immediately tries to convert shares into vault slots; velocity-flag target.

personas.name: Badge-farmer
personas.description: Optimizes runs for badge-shaped activity rather than discovery quality.

personas.name: Copycat farmer
personas.description: Copies whatever specs are being shared and mints them; copycat strategy with high minting goal.

personas.name: Systematic quant
personas.description: Sophisticated systematic user: screened universe, pairs and lead-lag runs in long sessions, low posting.

personas.name: Lead-lag hunter
personas.description: Hunts lead-lag relationships across a screened universe with long, focused sessions.

personas.name: Multifactor screener
personas.description: Combines factor screens with theme analysis; very low sharing.

personas.name: PIT-aware researcher
personas.description: Reads filings, checks registry depth before running; longest sessions, no sharing.

personas.name: Backtest-first user
personas.description: Always scans history before running live; methodical, low posting.

personas.name: Small-universe specialist
personas.description: Works a small niche watchlist deeply instead of scanning wide.

personas.name: Re-test specialist
personas.description: Re-tests existing registry cards rather than discovering new ones; zero sharing.

personas.name: Anchored-run user
personas.description: Uses anchored run mode: locks anchors and samples the subspace around them.

personas.name: Weekend casual
personas.description: Browses on weekends, occasional random runs, minimal minting.

personas.name: Lunch-break casual
personas.description: Quick lunchtime scan of the tips list; one pairs run occasionally.

personas.name: Occasional explorer
personas.description: Rarely opens the app; purely random pokes when they do.

personas.name: News-reader casual
personas.description: Follows market news casually and runs occasional narrative checks.

personas.name: Paper-trader casual
personas.description: Paper-trades off screener momentum; small weekly runs.

personas.name: Retirement-account casual
personas.description: Reviews long-term holdings occasionally; no minting, no sharing.

personas.name: Friend-referred casual
personas.description: Joined because a friend shared a card; copies suggested specs occasionally.

personas.name: Mobile-only casual
personas.description: Short mobile sessions between other things; posts more than they research.

personas.name: Dormant reactivated
personas.description: Was dormant, reactivated after seeing a post; catches up with a burst of random runs.

personas.name: Email-digest casual
personas.description: Acts only on the email digest; never shares.

personas.name: Day-zero sharer
personas.description: Creates an account and immediately tries to share before any completed run; posts are unverifiable. Target: day-zero denial.

personas.name: Burner sharer
personas.description: Burner accounts created and used the same day to attempt share grants from rotating IPs.

personas.name: Device farm
personas.description: One account driven from dozens of device ids on shared IPs/ASNs to farm share slots. Target: cluster velocity flag.

personas.name: IP ring
personas.description: A ring of accounts all claiming grants from one IP/ASN. Target: >=5 accounts on one device/IP flagged, never granted.

personas.name: VPN hopper
personas.description: Rotates exit IPs to dodge per-device rate limits while hammering grants. Target: rate-limit + cluster controls.

personas.name: Velocity hammer
personas.description: Mints easy cards then hammers share grants far past 3/device/30d. Target: denied_ratelimit.

personas.name: Cap buster
personas.description: Mints more distinct cards than the +5 slot cap allows and shares each with a fresh device. Target: cap refusal at 6th.

personas.name: Duplicate re-sharer
personas.description: Re-shares the same card from new post URLs to try to stack slots. Target: one slot per (account, card).

personas.name: Unverifiable poster
personas.description: Posts shares whose content fails live-post verification (no card link / no attribution tag). Target: grant must NOT fire.

personas.name: Screenshot poster
personas.description: Shares screenshots instead of public links; nothing verifiable. Target: unverifiable_post denial.

personas.name: Honeypot prober
personas.description: Deliberately attempts grants against planted canary accounts to detect share-farming services. Target: flagged, never granted.

personas.name: Coordinated share farm
personas.description: A coordinated farm: many accounts, shared devices/IPs/ASNs, scripted share posts. Target: the full §4.7 stack at once.
